mentions.name: Find Fantasy XVIII
mentions.description: A fan-made promotional website for Find Fantasy XVIII, an earnest pastiche of Final Fantasy games for a fictional game that does not exist. It uses the Nano Banana image generator to create facsimiles of Square Enix's promotional render style, with plans to add faked gameplay shots and FMV-style cutscene images.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I vibe-produced a website for an (earnest?) pastiche of Final Fantasy games (i.e., for a game that does not, and probably never will, exist). I noticed that Nano Banana could generate reasonable facsimiles of Square Enix's promotional render style and ran with it. Next up: faking some gameplay or a few shots from an FMV-style cutscene.

https://findfantasyxviii.com
